note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Ron and Friends 2026 is this league's first season on this board, and its first as a redraft. There is no previous draft, no standings, no keeper history and no recorded lore, so there is nothing here for the recap to argue from except tonight's board — which is the intended state, not a gap waiting to be filled.
whyThisMatters: This file is a RECAP INPUT. It reaches an Anthropic model through src/lib/league-lore.ts and src/lib/recap-grade-source.ts. The previous league's copy of this file carried ten manager personas, a decade of running jokes and a signed contract between two of its members. Rendered for these ten people it would have produced fluent, confident prose about strangers, on a television, with nothing in the build or the tests able to catch it. Empty is the only safe content until somebody records real facts about THIS league.
howToAddToIt: Facts go under `managers.<shortName>.notes`, each with a `fact`, a `source` and a `confidence`.
`verified` and `derived` may be quoted WITH their numbers. `inferred` and `unverified` may run the joke but must never state a round, a pick or a year.
Key on the short name from data/managers.json, never a first name.
Nothing invented. A fabricated callback is obvious to the room instantly and it discredits the real ones.

league.name: Ron and Friends
league.format: Redraft — no keepers in 2026, and no draft-pick trading at all.
league.priorSeasons: None on this board. The Sleeper league has no previous_league_id and every roster was empty at the draft.
